ORDINANCE

BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION 1. The Chicago Zoning Ordinance is amended by changing all of the C2-5,
Motor Vehicle-Related Commercial District symbols and indications as shown on Map
No. 13-G in the area bounded by:

      West Winnemac Avenue; North Broadway Avenue; West Argyle Street; the alley next
      west of and parallel to North Broadway Avenue; the alley next north of and parallel to
      West Argyle Street; and a line 156.39 feet west of and parallel to North Broadway
      Avenue,

to those of a C1-5, Neighborhood Commercial District.

SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be effective after its passage and publication.


                                                          ____________________________
                                                          Matthew J. Martin
                                                          Alderman, 47th Ward




Common Addresses:
5000-5126 N. Broadway Avenue
